findings.summary: Reuse atomic JSON record writing, canonical build-path keys, the scene registry and backend selection for native and generated lint results.
Batch clang-format inputs and recognize declaration macros for stable repeated formatting.
Share the required LLVM major version between discovery and validation.
Keep dynamic execution behind its typed boundary and separate Node tooling globals from browser init-script globals.
Validate API translations once and share decoding for encoded tuple and map reference types.
Reuse whitespace-independent native definition extraction that skips forward declarations.
Represent definition-only native functions with an absent prototype instead of an empty-string sentinel.
Retain event callbacks through owning captures, centralize identity-before-move registration and validate nullable selector cursors.
Choose mesh-buffer ownership through typed overloads and remove ineffective moves of fixed arrays, sprite properties and exception pointers.
Represent absent, fulfilled and rejected glTF promises with one variant discriminant and reuse the native allocation tracker.
Track only the rightmost effectful template substitution instead of allocating suffix state and repeating AST analysis.
Reuse canonical JSON shape readers rather than copying numeric arrays or duplicating string validation.
Move prepared Map keys and values into their persistent storage while preserving key/value aliasing and insertion order.
Use transparent glTF and source-JSON property lookup; allocate property-name strings only when inserting new fields and keep pointer fixtures on the same string-view contract.
Scan material arrays directly for native includes and numeric conversion while retaining snapshots for source callbacks.
Separate formatting and lint command grammars and preflight native tooling before reading all compilation databases.
Track native ownership classifications with transactional weak membership sets instead of copying growing sets during speculative lowering.
Centralize temporary-transfer admission while preserving borrowed views, generic handle companions and scalar feature isolation.
Share immutable-binding classification and the existing pinning policy across local, parameter and string lowering.
Reuse native string-parameter transfer logic across recursive and stored function bodies.
Compute replacement argument effects once for ordered string snapshots.
Use one lower-bound search and hinted insertion for material-property slots.
Retain callback array receivers without copying their complete contents; read live elements within the initial index range.
Prepare observable material assignment results before mutation and verify property-state rollback under allocation failure.
Mark immutable native aliases potentially unused when all source reads are consumed during generation, preserving warning-clean output without restoring copies.
Share reference-parameter borrowing admission across direct functions, recursive functions and recursive class methods.
Represent pinned borrowing with one mutable-or-stable discriminant instead of independent borrowed and stable flags.
Collect pinned parameter rebinding in one shared AST traversal per body rather than traversing once per parameter.
Consolidate immutable binding and snapshot selection, removing duplicate snapshot wrapping and an identical scene-type branch.
Use rightmost-effect indices for array and recursive argument snapshots; avoid native suffix arrays and repeated classification of already-admitted direct callees.
Derive managed-node counts directly from the dense registry and route runtime telemetry through the existing count API.
Reserve the known glTF map result length and transfer its prepared array storage into the owning material value.
Emit computed receiver selection, counted scoped lifetime ownership and retained Ref together in shared class hydration.
Reuse one fixture-tool discovery for maintained GC checks and include exact owner counts and failed registry-growth rollback.
Keep scoped receiver ownership in the shared Ref runtime while allowing suspended activations to release older or middle scopes without disturbing the current unique owner.

Borrow typed shared-cell arguments for direct numeric-buffer writers while retaining snapshots across callbacks and owning-reference slot replacement, with exact ownership and emitted-output regressions.
Keep immutable local borrowing separate from escaping capture ownership; reuse normal value and audio-companion capture registration instead of forcing reference captures.
